capabilities: Render -# lines as small muted text in Live Preview and Reading View
Toggle the -# prefix on the current line via command or hotkey
Configure subtext font size and text color
Hide the -# prefix in Editing View unless the cursor is on the line
disambiguation: Not a Discord integration; it only brings Discord's -# text syntax into Obsidian notes.
extras: API documentation is linked but not included in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Markdown syntax for small, muted subtext like Discord's -# prefix.
summary: Discord-style subtext formatter that renders lines starting with -# as small, muted text in Live Preview and Reading View.
